He keeps facing exactly the same direction the whole time and stays on his feet. Then he sways forward again, his arms drop limp and he settles cleanly into the starting hunched stance. He topples backward and falls flat onto the floor on his back, arms flopping out to the sides, legs sprawled, and he bounces very slightly as he lands. Then he lies completely still and motionless on the ground for the last frames, dead, flat on his back. He never gets up. No blood pool, no effects. Static camera, completely locked-off shot.
